sources.title: QCOM annual financial statements and economics
sources.excerpt: Qualcomm Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2025 Results. November 5, 2025. Fiscal year ended September 28, 2025. In millions except per share: Revenue 44,284 (2024 38,962); net income 5,541 (2024 10,142); diluted EPS 5.01 (2024 8.97), non-GAAP EPS 12.03. Non-cash $5.7 billion charge, or $5.29 per share, to establish valuation allowance against U.S. federal deferred tax assets because corporate alternative minimum tax expected beginning fiscal 2026; excluded from non-GAAP. QCT revenue 38,367; EBT11,670; EBT margin30%; QTL revenue5,582; EBT4,043; EBT margin72%. QCT Handsets27,793; Automotive3,957; IoT6,617. Annual stock repurchases56 million shares/$8,791 million; dividends$3,805 million/$3.48 per share. Balance sheet September28,2025 in millions: Cash and cash equivalents5,520; restricted cash2,323; marketable securities4,635; short-term debt0; long-term debt14,811; common shares issued and outstanding1,074 million (2024 1,113). Cash flow FY2025: operating cash flow14,012; capital expenditures(1,192); share-based compensation2,783; acquisitions and investments net(743). Risks: dependence on small number of customers/licensees, particularly premium handsets; customers vertically integrating; China concentration and U.S./China trade/national security tensions; patent-license renewal/renegotiation; attempts to avoid royalties; investigations/legal challenges; limited third-party suppliers; debt. Qualcomm Incorporated includes QTL and vast majority of patent portfolio; Qualcomm Technologies subsidiary operates QCT and engineering.

price.note: Observed regular close; post-split basis. No invented current timestamp.

shares.note: Actual common shares outstanding, not EPS weighted-average shares; filing date differs from quote date.

market_cap.note: Rounded vendor snapshot; billion USD multiplied by 1,000,000,000.

net_income.note: Consolidated GAAP net income, not necessarily common-attributable earnings.

capital_expenditure.note: Positive cash PP&E purchases; excludes acquisitions, investments and noncash leases.

cash.note: Consolidated cash and equivalents only; excludes restricted cash and investments.

debt.note: Narrow interest-bearing debt carrying value; excludes operating leases and preferred stock; sums disclosed current/noncurrent borrowing components.

eps.note: Annual GAAP diluted EPS; not adjusted or forward EPS.

risk_free_rate.note: Observed 10-year USD Treasury par yield 5.24%; percent converted to decimal. Current common reference, not a hardcoded tool default.

required_return.note: Analyst equity hurdle above sourced 5.24% 10-year Treasury; not observed cost of capital.

normalized_eps.note: Uses vendor GAAPTTM June28,2026EPS8.59 as assumedcurrentearningcapacity; annualFY2025EPS5.01 remains requiredhistoricalfact. Doesnot addback all nonGAAPexclusions or automaticallyextend distantFY2029targets.

timing.alignment_note: FY2025 ended 2025-09-28 historical GAAP EPS remains the reported anchor. The 8.59 USD/share capacity proxy is explicitly assumed at October11,2026 using vendor latest TTM rather than the older annual tax/cycle-distorted figure. 5 annual growth periods begin on valuation date and end at the calendar anniversary; exit P/E applies to hypothetical trailing twelve-month EPS at terminal date, not remote forward fiscal EPS. Dividends, interim distributions and incremental dilution are excluded; growth is per-share.
